headline: Bitcoin Miners Target AI Compute as Retail Mining Faces Cost Pressures
summary: Several companies are offering retail access to bitcoin mining without physical equipment, though high operational costs and the 2028 halving cloud profitability as large miners pursue AI revenues.
why: Cryptocurrency mining firms have increasingly diversified data center capacity into artificial intelligence workloads to secure stable cash flows against volatile mining rewards.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Shifting miner capacity toward AI compute and changes in mining participation influence network hash rate dynamics.
